title: SILENT HILL f
description:
Ebisugaoka is a rural town surrounded by mountains. In this deserted town, student Hinako Shimizu is filled with feelings that she has nowhere to turn. That morning, Hinako meets up with her classmates at her favorite candy store and enjoys a casual conversation. Despite the sense of claustrophobia, it should have been a normal day. Until that monster appears...

(My translations start from 3.2. The other chapters are already available on other sites)
author: Ryukishi07, Konami
